# ChloeDB

> ChloeDB is a search database with SQL: full text (BM25), vectors, graphs and structured fields in tables, embedded in a process (Rust, Python, JavaScript, Java) or served by chloedb-server over HTTP, gRPC and MCP, on one machine or a cluster. Its SQL is its own dialect, not Postgres: MATCH and bm25 for words, similarity for meaning, rrf to fuse them.

An agent connected to a chloedb-server over MCP (`{server}/v1/mcp`) gets these documents through its `search_docs` tool and its prompts. [Build with an AI agent](https://chloetech-ai.github.io/chloedb/guide/agents.md) says how to connect one and the prompts that work. The rendered site is https://chloetech-ai.github.io/chloedb/site/docs/.

- [Build with an AI agent](https://chloetech-ai.github.io/chloedb/guide/agents.md): An agent such as Claude Code can do most of what this documentation describes for you. It can load a file, make it searchable by words and by meaning, answer questions from your rows with citations, write the search…
- [Concepts](https://chloetech-ai.github.io/chloedb/guide/concepts.md): ChloeDB is a search engine and a database in one library. This page names the parts you meet when you use it: the file, tables and their fields, the three kinds of index every row gets, scores, the planner, and the…
- [Build an app on the HTTP API](https://chloetech-ai.github.io/chloedb/chloedb/build-an-app.md): A shop in one page: search, stock that never oversells, holds that expire, and click events counted exactly once. Each part is a few lines of SQL or JSON over HTTP, with links to the reference for the rest.
- [Troubleshooting](https://chloetech-ai.github.io/chloedb/chloedb/troubleshooting.md): The errors people meet first with ChloeDB, each with its message as the program prints it, what it means and what to do. Search this page for a few words of your message. These are the messages of release 0.3.8.

- [How ChloeDB works](https://chloetech-ai.github.io/chloedb/chloedb/index.md): ChloeDB is to search what SQLite is to relational data: a library that keeps a whole database in one file, needs no server or configuration, gives ACID transactions, and is queried with SQL. Every table is indexed…
